tasks.title: Email about conversation club
tasks.instruction:
You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

Read this email from your English teacher, Mrs. Hill, and the notes you have made.

Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English teacher, Mrs. Hill, and the notes you have made.

promptBlocks.subject: Conversation club for newcomers
paragraphs: As you know, our school is starting a conversation club for newcomers who are learning English. We want to help them practise speaking in a friendly environment.
First, should we meet on Tuesday afternoons or Friday afternoons? Which do you think is better for the newcomers?
Also, we need to choose an activity for the first session. Would you prefer a group discussion about hobbies or a role-play of ordering food?
Finally, can you suggest one way to make the newcomers feel welcome?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which day you prefer and explain why.
Choose an activity (group discussion or role-play) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to make newcomers feel welcome.
Ask Mrs. Hill about the number of newcomers expected.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Article about conversation club
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

You see this notice on a specialist magazine website for language teachers.

Write your article.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our school has started a conversation club for newcomers. Do you think conversation clubs help newcomers improve their speaking skills?
What is the most important thing the club should do to help them?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website!

tasks.title: Story about conversation club
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.

Your story must begin with this sentence:

"When the programme coordinator asked me to lead the conversation club, I felt both excited and nervous."

Write your story.
